newsitem.title: USA: Amgen extends deal with Roche.
newsitem.headline: Amgen extends deal with Roche.

text.p: Amgen Inc said on Monday it entered an agreement with Roche Holding Ltd's F. Hoffmann-La Roche Ltd, that extends Roche's participation in the sale of Neupogen in the European Union through the year 2010.
The agreement had been set to phase out over the next several years.

The companies also entered an agreement to collaborate on the development of a second generation Neupogen product for the European Union, under which Roche will grant Amgen rights to certain intellectual property in the U.S. and other geographic markets.
Current patents on Amgen's first-generation Neupogen product expire in the U.S. in the year 2013 and in Europe in 2006.
